public_definitions: The goal is to assign next quarter's premium retail promotion budget to the brand with the highest current market_share.
The dashboard market_share values are the evidence source.
The promotion rule is to allocate to the current market-share leader.
The campaign scope is next-quarter smartphone retail promotion.
